title: SAKAMOTO DAYS
synopsis:
Once hailed as the strongest hitman in history, Taro Sakamoto retired from the underworld after falling in love. After getting married and having a child, he now runs a convenience store—and has put on some weight!
However, Sakamoto is suddenly placed on a bounty of 1 billion yen, and assassins from all sides swarm in. To protect his beloved family and their peaceful everyday life, he must stick to his no-killing code and fight a life-or-death battle against his enemies!

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
曾被譽為史上最強殺手的坂本太郎，墮入愛河後金盆洗手，隱退江湖。結婚生子後經營著一間便利店，而且發福了！
然而，坂本突然被懸紅10億追殺，各方殺手蜂擁而至。為了守護摯愛的家人和平靜的日常，他必須貫徹不殺人的信念，與敵人展開一場生死搏鬥！

cast: Ren Meguro, Fumiya Takahashi, Aya Ueto, Mayu Yokota, Akihisa Shiono, Keisuke Watanabe, Hinako Sakurai, Shintaro Anzai, Junki Tozuka, Yusei Yagi, Meru Nukumi, Takumi Kitamura, Shinya Kote, Koji Kato, Kenjiro Tsuda
